visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up of a young woman with long dark hair, wearing a black and grey motorcycle helmet with a clear visor. She looks directly at the lens with a soft smile and gentle expression. Her shoulders are slightly angled, and the background is a blurry urban environment with bright natural daylight. (2) Medium full shot of the same woman sitting atop a bright green and blue electric scooter. She wears a white and grey horizontal striped off-the-shoulder long-sleeved shirt and short light-colored shorts. She is in a paved public space under a concrete bridge structure with green grass in the background. (3) Series of close-up shots focusing on the scooter's exterior. One sticker shows a woman wearing headphones holding a computer mouse with the text 'PLAY TO WIN'. Another shows a different woman in a blue cheerleader-style outfit making a heart shape with her hands. The scooter has a 'Logitech G' and 'WeMo' logo. (4) The woman points to a large sticker of a girl in a blue outfit on the front of the scooter's white body. She then touches her cheek and smiles at the camera. Yellow and white subtitles appear at the bottom of the frame over her image. (5) The woman stands in a grassy park during daylight. She is seen opening the seat of the scooter, leaning forward to look inside. She puts her hand to her mouth in a gesture of surprise and delight. A white helmet rests on the back of the scooter seat. (6) The woman holds a blue and purple rectangular coupon card towards the camera. Graphic overlays of a computer mouse and various character keychains float around her as she gestures with her hands, pointing and waving to emphasize the rewards. The lighting is warm. (7) Wide shot of the woman posing next to the scooter in a large open park area with green grass and city buildings in the distance. The sun is low, creating a golden hour glow. She waves both hands in the air and then points towards the scooter's handlebars.

(3) [Subtitle]: 電競妖精珠珠跟電玩美少女小迪在WeMo上出現啦！ (4) [Subtitle]: 陪你一起騎車！超Q吧！ [Slogan]: RIDE TO WIN. (5) [Subtitle]: 重點來了！只要你夠幸運騎到這兩台其中一台. (6) [Subtitle]: 記得馬上開車廂！裡面藏著超級讚的「車廂禮」喔！ (7) [Subtitle]: 有限量的 Q 萌吊飾還有 Logi Store 的 $100 折價券！ (8) [Subtitle]: 騎一次車就賺到真的太佛心！ (9) [Subtitle]: 還沒完！拿著這個折價券去 Logi Store 買電競商品. (10) [Subtitle]: 消費滿額可以拿到金屬限量版吊飾. (11) [Subtitle]: 還有機會抽到珠珠的「簽名滑鼠」或是「簽名明信片」！ (12) [Subtitle]: 哇賽！整個大獎直接升級！ (13) [Subtitle]: 活動只到 12/31 喔！別再等了這根本是城市尋寶記嘛！ (14) [Subtitle]: 快打開你的 WeMo App 輸入我的專屬折扣碼吧！ (15) [Subtitle]: 馬上出發去尋找你的專屬電競女神車吧！

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young woman with long dark hair and bangs. She is wearing a grey and white horizontal striped off-the-shoulder top, light-colored shorts, white sneakers, and a black motorcycle helmet.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy female voice narration begins over a mid-tempo upbeat electronic pop BGM. Vocal pitch is high and delivery is enthusiastic with clear articulation. The BGM features a steady 4/4 electronic drum beat and bright synthesizer melodies at approximately 124 BPM. (2) A sharp synthetic 'whoosh' sound effect occurs, signifying a technical transition between audio segments. The narrator continues speaking rapidly with a rising intonation, emphasizing the brand names 'WeMo' and 'Logitech'. The music continues with constant spectral brightness. (3) A high-pitched 'ding' or sparkle sound effect triggers over the primary narration as specific rewards are listed. The narrator's vocal arousal increases significantly, reaching peak intensity and loudness. The BGM maintains its rhythmic drive without interruption. (4) The final audio phase features the narrator providing a closing call to action with a warm, friendly tone. The music and speech overlap continuously until the track ends with a rapid fade-out, maintaining a clean studio-grade signal-to-noise ratio throughout.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Information Delivery -> Reward Reveal -> Call to Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote a limited-edition collaboration between WeMo electric scooters and Logitech G gaming products, encouraging users to find special branded scooters to win prizes like coupons and exclusive merchandise.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video explicitly names and shows stickers for 'Logitech G' and 'WeMo', provides a discount code, and outlines a specific promotional event.
